div.div: Future implementation content This page is provided to show the expected direction of future implementation work. It is not part of the proposed material for evaluation in this publication; mappings, target artefacts and profiling details are expected to evolve in subsequent iterations of this guide.

Yellow row/cells: In this ballot publication, some row/cells of the mapping table have been left in yellow to indicate areas requiring further review or refinement; including feedback from the Xt-EHR joint action (see note above). These highlights will be addressed in subsequent updates to ensure accuracy and completeness of the mappings.

body.p: This page explains how elements from the CancerStage logical model are expressed in the FHIR Resource ObservationCancerStageEuCcm resource used by this Implementation Guide.

tr.td: Only the CancerConditionCcm can be referenced.
In this element the code of the clissification system used must be entered.

For a single component grading system use the value element. For multi component system use the component.value element. This must be seen as a pair with the component.code, as this elements codes the staging component being reported.
Here the staging component is entered. The difference to the code element lies here that the component and not the system is being reported.
Smomed CT ValueSet must be used.
Here the ProcedureSurgeryEuCcm can be referenced. This should be filled out, if the type is pathological
Here the ObservationImagingEuCcm can be referenced. This should be filled out, if the type is clinical.
